claims.text: Fully convolutional networks trained end-to-end pixels-to-pixels exceed segmentation state-of-the-art: contemporary classifiers (AlexNet/VGG/GoogLeNet) adapted to FCNs with transferred representations plus deep-coarse/shallow-fine skip fusion reach 62.2% mean IU on VOC 2012 (20% relative gain), with sub-1/5-second inference.
Historical role (VM-O03): dense-prediction origin — classification nets reframed as a special case of FCNs; the transfer (classification-to-segmentation fine-tuning) contract.
